_comment: Pilot config. Purpose is harness and reporting validation, NOT results. Two cells testing decision rule only, on free-tier models. See _caveats.

_caveats.confounded: consensus is paired with round_robin and advisory with fixed_leader, so an outcome difference cannot be attributed to either factor. This reproduces the bundling the original repo had. Acceptable here because the pilot tests plumbing, not hypotheses. Use configs/ablations.json for the crossed grid.
_caveats.models: Free-tier models are heavily rate limited and are non-reasoning or small-reasoning. LLM Chess (arXiv:2512.01992) puts this class near 71.9% instruction-following errors, so expect high illegal-move rates. For validation that is a feature: it exercises the illegal-move, false-consensus and resolution-fallback paths that good models would rarely touch.
_caveats.not_for_results: Nothing produced under this config should be reported as a finding.

orgs.name: Pilot Consensus
orgs.description: Heterogeneous free-tier trio, consensus rule, rotating submitter

agents.persona: aggressive attacker who prefers tactical combinations and sharp openings
defensive player who prioritizes piece safety and solid pawn structure
balanced player who evaluates long-term positional advantages

orgs.name: Pilot Advisory
orgs.description: Same heterogeneous trio, advisory rule, fixed leader

agents.persona: experienced strategist who weighs advisor input but trusts own judgement
tactical specialist focused on immediate material gain and threats
positional expert who prefers strategic maneuvering and piece coordination
